Step 1

One place to post.

Keep using Facebook for music nights and news. An authorised feed service can bring those posts onto the website.

What would happen next?

“Connect to Facebook” would open Facebook’s own authorisation screen. The Page manager would sign in and review the requested access there.

This walkthrough opens a simulated Page selection screen.
